name: Vector Cross Product and Exact Rational Objective Obfuscation
description: Replaced the algebraic symmetry constraint with a 3D vector cross-product condition that evaluates to the zero vector if and only if the assigned multipliers are equal. Replaced the iterative base-4 signature calculation with an exact mathematical summation of a rational series, which perfectly preserves the lexicographical tie-breaking requirement but introduces a severe precision trap for models that rely on standard floating-point evaluation without recognizing the underlying combinatorial structure.
